training_data: synthetic harmonic signals and a bounded DSP teacher policy; no commercial recordings

pitch_cnn.architecture: 2x32 -> Conv1d(4,kernel=5,pad=2) tanh -> flatten -> dense12 tanh -> sigmoid

limits: Synthetic evaluation is not validation on real singers.
Auto-mix learns engineering targets, not professional aesthetic preferences.
CNN scores pitch candidates; it does not separate polyphonic notes.
